input: Finite transient states, specified absorbing repair/failure, rational macro probabilities, an ordered finite list of eligible-contact counts for each macro outcome
assumptions: Each reached stage executes before testing. Conditional hazard h*t is in [0,1]. At the first accepted loss the history stops. The macro proposal and the conditional trials have the specified conditional law.
certificates: Remove the power at zero from each difference; sign-uniform Bernstein coefficients on the parameter interval imply a strict separation
For a finite family the maximum vanishing order of nonidentical differences gives the asymptotic order of its minimum gap when every normalized difference has a nonzero leading coefficient
boundaries: A single trajectory is a binary readout, not an identification experiment
No lumping claim at delta=0 from loss alone
